description: This file defines the LatLngBounds class and related functions for handling rectangular geographical areas on a map, including methods for extending, padding, retrieving corners, containment, intersection, overlap, and conversion to bounding box string.

classes.name: LatLngBounds
classes.description: Represents a rectangular geographical area with methods to manipulate and query bounds.

methods.name: LatLngBounds
methods.description: Constructor function to create a LatLngBounds object from two corners or an array of points.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the bounds to include a given point or bounds.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Returns new bounds extended or retracted by a specified ratio.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the center point of the bounds.

methods.name: getSouthWest
methods.description: Returns the south-west corner of the bounds.

methods.name: getNorthEast
methods.description: Returns the north-east corner of the bounds.

methods.name: getNorthWest
methods.description: Returns the north-west corner of the bounds.

methods.name: getSouthEast
methods.description: Returns the south-east corner of the bounds.

methods.name: getWest
methods.description: Returns the western longitude of the bounds.

methods.name: getSouth
methods.description: Returns the southern latitude of the bounds.

methods.name: getEast
methods.description: Returns the eastern longitude of the bounds.

methods.name: getNorth
methods.description: Returns the northern latitude of the bounds.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the bounds contain a given point or bounds.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Checks if the bounds intersect with another bounds.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if the bounds overlap with another bounds.

methods.name: toBBoxString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the bounds suitable for web service requests.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if the bounds are equivalent to another bounds within a margin.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the bounds are properly initialized.

methods.name: toLatLngBounds
methods.description: Factory function to create or return a LatLngBounds object from given points.
